content: Semantics of a GlobalTimeGateway In order to achieve the flow of information between a GlobalTimeSlave of a given GlobalTimeDomain to the GlobalTimeMaster of another GlobalTimeDomain , it is necessary to establish the existence of a so-called GlobalTimeGateway . In terms of functionality, a GlobalTimeGateway complements the functionality of the underlying Gateway such that, on top of the mere routing from one Communication- Cluster to another, the time information is actively updated in the process of passing it from one GlobalTimeDomain to the other.
